title: Match Canvas Window Gutter To Edge Inset
description: Spacing between windows inside the Mode canvas is too small. It should match the distance to the edge of the canvas.
summary: Mode canvas inter-window spacing now matches the outer inset: splitters use orientation-based w-double/h-double classes instead of dead data-[panel-group-direction] variants (react-resizable-panels never set that attribute, so gutters stayed w-px). Introduced MODE_CANVAS_INSET_CLASS shared with mode-body padding; ResizablePanelGroup now exposes data-panel-group-direction for cursor styling. Extended regression test.
